title: 肠-脑-皮肤轴与特应性皮炎中医证候研究
snippet: 围绕特应性皮炎、肠-脑-皮肤轴与中医证候关联进行综述，强调脾虚湿蕴、血虚风燥等证候与皮肤屏障、神经免疫调节之间的联系。
abstract: 文章从肠-脑-皮肤轴视角讨论特应性皮炎的中医证候演变，提出脾虚湿蕴、血虚风燥与肠道微生态失衡、皮肤屏障异常和神经免疫调节紊乱之间存在可解释关联。

title: 基于文献证据的特应性皮炎中药复方干预机制分析
snippet: 总结消风散、当归饮子等常用复方在炎症因子调节、皮肤屏障修复和瘙痒缓解方面的研究证据。
abstract: 综述特应性皮炎常用中药复方的基础与临床研究，归纳其在 Th2 炎症抑制、屏障修复和瘙痒控制中的潜在作用。

title: 肠道菌群失衡与特应性皮炎发病关系研究进展
snippet: 聚焦双歧杆菌、乳酸杆菌下降与炎症偏移，讨论肠道菌群干预对 AD 的潜在意义。
abstract: 文章归纳了特应性皮炎患者肠道菌群结构改变的主要发现，并讨论菌群干预在免疫稳态恢复中的可能作用。

title: 特应性皮炎中西医结合诊疗专家共识中的证据要点
snippet: 提炼中西医结合诊疗共识中关于分型辨证、屏障修复、抗炎与长期管理的关键证据。
authors: 中华医学会皮肤性病学分会
abstract: 共识文件总结了特应性皮炎长期管理中的证据基础，强调皮肤屏障维护、炎症控制和个体化辨证施治。

title: 特应性皮炎瘙痒机制与中医药干预思路
snippet: 讨论 IL-31、神经肽、睡眠障碍与瘙痒恶性循环，并总结中医药外治与内治策略。
abstract: 文章从神经免疫角度梳理特应性皮炎瘙痒机制，并总结内服外用中医药在瘙痒控制中的应用证据。

title: 特应性皮炎皮肤屏障损伤与修复策略的中医药研究
snippet: 总结 filaggrin、神经酰胺与角质层功能异常，并讨论中药改善屏障的实验研究。
abstract: 围绕皮肤屏障损伤这一核心病理环节，综述中药及复方在修复角质层功能和调节炎症中的研究证据。

title: 基于网络药理学的特应性皮炎常用方剂作用机制研究综述
snippet: 归纳网络药理学研究中高频成分、靶点与通路，指出 PI3K-Akt、NF-kB、JAK-STAT 是常见轴线。
abstract: 综述网络药理学在特应性皮炎中药方剂研究中的常见对象、核心靶点和信号通路，为后续实验验证提供线索。

title: 中医外治法在特应性皮炎管理中的证据综述
snippet: 聚焦药浴、湿敷、软膏等外治法在瘙痒、渗出和皮损缓解中的应用证据。
abstract: 文章总结了特应性皮炎外治法的临床应用研究，强调症状缓解与屏障修复之间的配合关系。

title: 儿童特应性皮炎中医证治特点与文献证据
snippet: 讨论儿童 AD 常见湿热、脾虚、血虚风燥证型及其与年龄分层管理的关系。
abstract: 从儿童患者的疾病特点出发，总结中医证型分布与治疗思路，并回顾相关文献证据。

title: 特应性皮炎中医药研究热点与证据图谱综述
snippet: 从关键词共现和研究主题演化角度总结 AD 中医药研究热点，涵盖菌群、屏障、炎症通路与复方机制。
abstract: 综述特应性皮炎中医药研究的主要主题演化，提示肠道菌群、屏障修复与网络药理学是持续升温方向。

title: Atopic dermatitis, skin barrier dysfunction, and immune pathways
snippet: Reviewing barrier disruption, Th2 skewing, and epithelial cytokines as central drivers of atopic dermatitis.
abstract: This review summarizes how barrier disruption, alarmins, and type 2 inflammation interact in atopic dermatitis and discusses implications for targeted therapy.

title: Gut microbiome signatures associated with atopic dermatitis severity
snippet: Associating reduced microbial diversity and altered short-chain fatty acid metabolism with AD severity.
abstract: The study links gut microbial diversity loss and altered metabolite profiles with clinical severity in atopic dermatitis, supporting gut-skin axis hypotheses.

title: Neuroimmune mechanisms of itch in atopic dermatitis
snippet: Summarizing IL-31, sensory neurons, and the self-reinforcing itch-scratch cycle in AD.
abstract: This review focuses on how neuroimmune crosstalk, including IL-31 signaling and sensory neuron activation, sustains itch in atopic dermatitis.

title: Herbal interventions for atopic dermatitis: a systematic review of clinical studies
snippet: Reviewing clinical studies of herbal formulas for eczema severity, itch relief, and quality of life outcomes.
abstract: The review evaluates clinical evidence for herbal interventions in atopic dermatitis and highlights heterogeneity in study quality and outcome measures.

title: JAK-STAT signaling as a therapeutic axis in atopic dermatitis
snippet: Discussing cytokine-driven JAK-STAT activation and its relevance to targeted therapies in AD.
abstract: This paper reviews cytokine-mediated JAK-STAT activation in atopic dermatitis and explains why this pathway has become a major therapeutic target.

title: Filaggrin deficiency and epidermal barrier failure in atopic dermatitis
snippet: Connecting filaggrin loss-of-function, transepidermal water loss, and enhanced allergen penetration.
abstract: The article explains how filaggrin deficiency contributes to barrier failure and increased susceptibility to immune activation in atopic dermatitis.

title: Probiotics and prebiotics in the management of atopic dermatitis
snippet: Evaluating microbial interventions, responder heterogeneity, and evidence limits in AD prevention and treatment.
abstract: This review summarizes evidence for probiotics and prebiotics in atopic dermatitis, noting subgroup effects and limitations across studies.

title: Network pharmacology approaches to herbal formula research in atopic dermatitis
snippet: Describing how herbal formula studies prioritize compounds, targets, and pathways in AD using network pharmacology.
abstract: The article outlines common network pharmacology workflows used to study herbal formulas in atopic dermatitis and discusses validation challenges.

title: Skin microbiome dysbiosis and Staphylococcus aureus dominance in atopic dermatitis
snippet: Reviewing how microbial imbalance, especially S. aureus expansion, correlates with flares and barrier injury.
abstract: This review examines the role of skin microbiome dysbiosis and Staphylococcus aureus dominance in disease flares and barrier dysfunction in atopic dermatitis.

title: Pediatric atopic dermatitis phenotypes and longitudinal management considerations
snippet: Summarizing phenotype heterogeneity, age-dependent presentation, and long-term management priorities in pediatric AD.
abstract: The paper discusses phenotype diversity and age-dependent disease features in pediatric atopic dermatitis, emphasizing long-term management strategies.
